title: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer (CDL)
fetched: 18 annual clips (2008-2025) for the pilot box; 252 field-year crop labels
resolution: Source 30 m (10 m for 2024, 2025); clipped with nearest-neighbour sampling to a 30 m Web-Mercator grid; annual
credit: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service Cropland Data Layer. Published crop-specific data layer, USDA-NASS, Washington, DC. Public domain.
access: USDA CroplandCROS image service: https://pdi.scinet.usda.gov/image/rest/services/CDL_WM/ImageServer/exportImage (CropScape GetCDLFile kept as a fallback; it timed out when this pipeline was built)
notes: A satellite-derived classification, not a ground record: individual field-years can be mislabelled (alfalfa vs other hay is a common confusion). The app shows the share of the field that carried the label and asks the farmer to correct it.
